title: GrantEvent
description: The payload of every grant event (docs/design/m0/04 "Grants", "Read authorization"): <transition>/v1, i.e. grant.created/v1 or grant.revoked/v1, with the grant as issued and, once revoked, when. The event's subject is the grant. A narrowing is a revocation and a new grant. internal/authority checks every transition against the current record in the writer transaction; long-lived streams re-check authority against these records.
